"""Resume frozen v4 without rewriting identical completed gate summaries."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import sys

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
HERE = PROJECT / "evals/production-2026-10-25"
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import runner
import controller_v4


def main():
    assert not (PROJECT / ".local/production-v4-controller.lock").exists()
    assert not list((PROJECT / ".local/production-runtime").glob("*/active-suite.lock"))
    freeze = runner.read(HERE / "results/v4/candidate-freeze.json")
    assert runner.digest(Path(controller_v4.__file__)) == freeze["controller_sha256"]
    bindings = {
        (HERE / "results/v4/safety-iteration3.json").resolve(): "safety_summary_sha256",
        (HERE / "results/v4/routing-iteration3.json").resolve(): "routing_summary_sha256",
    }
    saved = {}
    for path, field in bindings.items():
        assert runner.digest(path) == freeze[field]
        saved[path] = runner.read(path)
    original_write = runner.write

    def preserve_completed_summary(path, value):
        path = Path(path).resolve()
        if path not in saved:
            return original_write(path, value)
        expected = dict(saved[path])
        observed = dict(value)
        assert "completed_at" in expected and "completed_at" in observed
        expected.pop("completed_at")
        observed.pop("completed_at")
        if observed != expected:
            raise ValueError("Recomputed gate differs beyond summary timestamp: " + str(path))
        assert runner.digest(path) == freeze[bindings[path]]
        print(json.dumps({"resume_preserved_frozen_summary": path.name,
                          "all_non_timestamp_fields_identical": True}), flush=True)

    runner.write = preserve_completed_summary
    try:
        return controller_v4.main(3, HERE / "candidates/v4-python/SKILL.md")
    finally:
        runner.write = original_write
        for path, field in bindings.items():
            assert runner.digest(path) == freeze[field]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
